description_en: Queries the collection cycle configuration of Asset Fingerprints
description_zh: 查询资产指纹采集周期配置
name: GetPropertyScheduleConfig

parameters.help_en:
The type of Asset Fingerprints for which the automatic collection frequency is configured. Valid values:

scheduler_port_period: listening port
scheduler_process_period: running process
scheduler_account_period: account asset
scheduler_software_period: software asset
scheduler_cron_period: scheduled node
scheduler_sca_period: middleware
scheduler_autorun_period: startup item
scheduler_lkm_period: kernel module
scheduler_sca_proxy_period: website
parameters.help_zh:
自动采集频率的资产指纹的类型。取值：

scheduler_port_period：监听端口
scheduler_process_period：运行进程
scheduler_account_period：账号资产
scheduler_software_period：软件资产
scheduler_cron_period：计划任务
scheduler_sca_period：中间件
scheduler_autorun_period：启动项
scheduler_lkm_period：内核模块
scheduler_sca_proxy_period：Web站点
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server to query.
You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的服务器的UUID。
调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: uuid

PropertyScheduleConfig.description_en: The collection cycle configuration of Asset Fingerprints
PropertyScheduleConfig.description_zh: 资产指纹采集周期配置信息

NextScheduleTime.description_en: The estimated timestamp when the next Asset Fingerprints collection starts. Unit: milliseconds
NextScheduleTime.description_zh: 预计下次资产指纹采集开始的时间戳，单位毫秒

ScheduleTime.description_en:
The collection frequency of Asset Fingerprints. Valid values:

0: Disabled. Periodic automatic collection of Asset Fingerprints is not performed.
1: Collected once every hour.
3: Collected once every 3 hours.
12: Collected once every 12 hours.
24: Collected once every day.
168: Collected once every 7 days
ScheduleTime.description_zh:
资产指纹的采集频率。取值：

0：关闭，即不进行周期性的资产指纹自动采集
1：每1小时采集1次
3：每3小时采集1次
12：每12小时采集1次
24：每天采集1次
168：每7天采集1次
